Direct pairwise triangle bounds give \(\|\mathbf h+\mathbf k\|+\|\mathbf h-\mathbf k\|\le2\); the \(2\times3\) semiaxis matrix yields \(G\succeq\tau^2\operatorname{diag}(a^{-2},b^{-2})\), hence \(\tau\le ab/r\). Explicit rank-one effects yield a nilpotent compressed matrix attaining equality. Equality in PSD and triangle bounds gives orthogonal Bloch directions of prescribed lengths, uniform four weights, and unique row-Gram effects modulo an SU(2) change of basis and independent ambient diagonal phases. All conditions a,b>0 hold; exact rational checker passes eight cases but is not the proof.

value.rationale: Provides the natural complete four-vertex rectangular normal-spectrum counterpart to known at-most-three-point triangle calculations. The width \(2ab/\sqrt{a^2+b^2}\) is strictly below the geometric inradius diameter \(2\min(a,b)\), with a square giving \(\sqrt2\) against \(2\). The entire set of attaining compressions forms a single diagonal-unitary orbit, and the maximizing numerical-range disk is unique. This is an exact motivated operator invariant and complete equality classification, not just a normalization check or small table.
